name: NGC 2154 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2154, an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2154-hubble
story: NGC 2154 is an intermediate-age star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way. Its main-sequence turnoff is broadened, one of the clues that such clusters are not the simple single-age crowds once assumed.

claims.text: NGC 2154 is an intermediate-age Large Magellanic Cloud cluster
NGC 2154 was a target of program 12257 on Magellanic Cloud star clusters
The Large Magellanic Cloud is a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way
Such clusters challenge the idea of simple stellar populations
NGC 2154 shows a broadened main-sequence turnoff
The pointing was chosen to overlap earlier Hubble ACS images
